name: Recumbent Cycling

instructions.description: Adjust the seat so the knees remain slightly bent at full reach.
Sit back against the support and place feet in the pedals.
Pedal smoothly at a manageable resistance.
Slow the pedals gradually before stopping.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Record average movement or step cadence.
Record the individual's perceived effort after the exercise.

variations.variationDescription: Stationary Cycling provides a meaningfully different loading, support, or stability option compared with Recumbent Cycling.
Recumbent Cycling — Interval Progression: Alternate manageable work and recovery periods while keeping the same activity.

commentsNotes: Use the back support and adjust the seat reach.
